name: touchdesigner-mcp-setdesign
description: Set Design fork: bounded network snapshots, preview-first layout, and safe TOP capture
long_description:
# TouchDesigner MCP — Set Design

An MIT-licensed fork of 8beeeaaat/touchdesigner-mcp, maintained by Sarvesh Chidambaram. Adds bounded graph snapshots, preview-first coordinate layout, and safe TOP image capture. This launcher installs the exact fork release from its GitHub tarball; it does not use the upstream npm package.

Includes the original node operations, Python execution, documentation tools, and tool manifests. The local execution bridge has full access to the TouchDesigner process and should remain on loopback.

tools.name: describe_td_tools
tools.description: Generate filesystem manifests of TouchDesigner tools with detailLevel/responseFormat/filter options for code execution environments
